Introduces a preview skill for Klaviyo with Agiexa, ahead of its November 2026 launch.

- Explains planned Klaviyo capabilities, use cases, connection setup, and security controls.
- Clarifies that no integrations or actions are available today; agents must not claim to access apps or perform tasks.
- Provides guidance and links for exploring the integration and its planned tools.
- Adds a permission-based waitlist flow requiring confirmed details and consent before submission.
